summary: Stable releases publish only when the Compounding Manager acts after the Fractal Product Lead records GO for the exact full candidate source SHA. Daily candidates target that SHA without creating a tag; publication creates the tag and preserves the optional operator summary verbatim.

rules.detail: No runtime checkpoint or retention changes. Daily release cleanup deletes older semantic-version unpublished drafts only after a newer complete candidate is successfully created; published releases and prereleases are untouched.

compatibility.detail: No binary or wire changes; consumers must pin only published release tags, never draft candidate version names.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment occurs when creating a candidate.

manual.detail: Dispatch mode=candidate with an exact full sha from main first-parent history to build that source in isolated SHA-keyed concurrency, then draft its verified archives; newer main pushes cannot cancel it. The optional summary is preserved verbatim. After Product Lead exact-SHA GO, Compounding Manager dispatches mode=publish with tag, sha and go_ref. Publication requires a successful build run for that source and matching original build artifacts; publish within their seven-day retention or build a fresh candidate. A newer draft blocks publication unless allow_superseded exactly names the selected older tag. Candidates create no tags and never advance baselines. See docs/st3/binary-releases.md.

recovery.detail: All candidate selection, draft creation, cleanup and publication serialize under one shared job-level mutation lock, while builds remain SHA-isolated. GitHub can cancel an older pending job when a third arrives; a cancellation observer fails the workflow visibly. On cancellation, check current release state and re-dispatch with all original inputs; never assume publication completed. A rejected publish leaves the candidate unpublished. Correct the SHA or GO reference, select a newer candidate, or explicitly name the older tag with allow_superseded. If build proof expired, create a fresh candidate. Cleanup rechecks draft status by release ID immediately before deleting that same ID. Never move a published tag.
